latest.title: Minimizers of Laplace eigenvalues under a lower curvature bound
latest.abstract: We prove a sharp comparison, with Obata-type rigidity, for all Neumann eigenvalues of one-dimensional $\mathrm{CD}(1,2)$ spaces against the Legendre model, under a convexity condition on the density. It follows that minimizers of the $k$-th Laplace eigenvalue among closed surfaces of Gaussian curvature at least $1$ cannot collapse in the measured Gromov-Hausdorff completion, for every $k\ge2$. We also give a variational proof that smooth minimizers are round.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 在密度满足凸性条件的一维 CD(1,2) 空间中，与 Legendre 模型比较所有 Neumann 特征值，并推出曲率至少一的闭曲面第 k≥2 个特征值极小者不塌缩。
techniques: 变分与 Obata 型刚性
latest.breakthrough: 将一维尖锐模型转化为曲面谱极小问题的紧性信息，并以变分证明光滑极小者为圆球。
latest.limitations: 一维比较有密度凸性假设；非塌缩与光滑极小者分类并不自动给出所有奇异极小者的正则性。
latest.priorityReason: 连接合成曲率、塌缩与谱优化，应用清晰；保留密度与正则性范围后适合重点方向延伸阅读。
